analysis.title: GS Laicini - Prime HFs Update Nov 5th at US Close
key_insights: Broader market sell-off on 5 Nov 2026. At the US close, GS estimates Global Fundamental LS managers were down 1.3%, a -2 SD move, driven mainly by market/beta exposure. YTD performance is +8.7%.
TMT funds fell more than 4% and are now roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, down from about +24% before the June/July AI sell-off.
US-focused funds were down 1.7% and are up 5.5% YTD.
Systematic LS managers were up 0.2%, with gains in the U.S. and EM Asia offsetting losses in Europe and DM Asia. They are up 16% YTD.
Multi-Strats managers were down 1.4%, driven by the sell-off in high-beta names, Info Tech, Momentum (down 3.7 SD), and negative idiosyncratic returns.
risk_factors: Beta-driven sell-off in high-beta names and Info Tech hit fundamental and multi-strat hedge funds.
Momentum factor reversal of 3.7 SD hurt Multi-Strats.
TMT funds have given back most of their YTD gains since the June/July AI sell-off.
vol_and_positioning: Global Fundamental LS managers fell 1.3% on 5 Nov, a -2 SD daily move, mostly from market/beta exposure.
TMT funds fell more than 4% on the day and are roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, versus about +24% before the June/July AI sell-off.
Momentum factor fell 3.7 SD on the day, hitting Multi-Strats, which were down 1.4%.
Systematic LS managers were up 0.2% on the day and are up 16% YTD, the strongest YTD performance among the groups cited.
